author: JoeVC
body:
Ok, so recently I have become a known guy for playing some smashing tunes, I'm not talking your average Justin Beiber hits - although his new album was fire, I'm talking absolute bangers that have set fire to this millennium in the music world. I can play some absolute tunes on the guitar, play harmonies on the harmonica and fiddle with the Ukulele. 

Okay so to start, i have some smashing playlists. See the links if you don't believe me. https://gyazo.com/b644236ebdcc4497479a4fd466600efe

Now if you believe me, you will of made a good decision, If you doubt me, then you shall burn in the firey infernos of my mixtape #dropitlikesithot #wasteman.

But you see, I'm not a mean guy, so i left it up to you, the proper 'merican way - Vote here - http://goo.gl/V9Iivu
